intro: Stronger feelings: being fed up, not being able to stand something, not caring, and changing mood.
p.estoy harto de.nota: Use harta when the speaker is feminine: estoy harta de.
p.me da igual: I don't care, it's all the same to me
p.me pone de mal humor: it puts me in a bad mood
p.me da pena: it makes me sad, I feel sorry
b1.texto:
**Estar harto de** takes a noun, an infinitive or **que** + subjunctive: estoy harta **del** ruido; estoy harto **de esperar**; estoy harto **de que llegues** tarde.

**No soportar** also takes a noun, an infinitive or **que** + subjunctive: no soporto **el** calor; no soporto **esperar**; no soporto **que me griten**.

An infinitive can name an activity or what the person feeling does: **me pone de mal humor madrugar**, **me da pena irme**. Use **que** + subjunctive to react to a finite clause, especially someone else's action: **me pone de mal humor que hagan ruido**, **me da pena que te vayas**.

**Me da igual** shows indifference: me da igual el precio; me da igual **que venga** o no.

A change of mood can use **ponerse** or other pronominal verbs: **me pongo** triste, **me enfado**, **me aburro**, **me deprimo**.

When it is too much: **¡No puedo más!** **¡Basta ya!**
b2.f0: I can't take any more! I'm fed up with the neighbours making noise.
b2.f1: Again? I don't mind; I sleep very well.
b2.f2: Well, I can't stand them putting music on at three.
b2.f4: Yes, and they got angry with me. Seeing them puts me in a bad mood.
b2.f5: I'm sorry you're like this. Shall we look for another flat?
b4.pregunta: Complete: I'm fed up with waiting.
b5.pregunta: Complete: I can't stand people shouting at me.
b5.o1.refuerzo: After no soporto que, the subjunctive.
b5.o2.refuerzo: This clause needs a conjugated verb: griten.
b6.pregunta: Complete with the infinitive: getting up early puts me in a bad mood.
b6.o0.refuerzo: Use the infinitive to name the activity: madrugar.
b6.o1.refuerzo: This finite clause would say someone else gets up early.
b6.o2.refuerzo: Name the activity with the infinitive: madrugar.
b8.pregunta: Which verb shows a change of mood?
b9.traduccion: I'm fed up with them making noise.
b10.texto:
**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (100–120 words).** Write a complaint about something you are fed up with in your building or neighbourhood, and what you cannot stand.

**Speak (about 2 minutes).** Complain aloud to a friend about three things that annoy you, and say what you do not mind.
b7.o0.explicacion: Me da igual means it makes no difference to me, so I don't care.
